entities.summary: Yevgeny Leonidovich Krinov, D.G.S., was a Soviet Russian astronomer and geologist, born in Otyassy village in the Morshansky District of the Tambov Governorate of the Russian Empire. Krinov was a renowned meteorite researcher; the mineral Krinovite, discovered in 1966, was named after him.
